content.text: {"label":"unknown_demand_surge","explanation":"General volume has run above forecast all day (+31% so far) and is accelerating (+64% at 18:00, alert +53%). The rise is spread across all reasons: account_update 1.57x, balance_enquiry 1.48x, and login, loan and other_general about 1.3x. No single driver stands out. The open incidents are P4 with no customer impact (staff email, branch printers). The only marketing send is a social fraud-awareness post, which would mainly lift payments fraud_report, and that is only slightly raised. General absences (1 vs about 2.2 usual) are normal, and AHT is at or below forecast. This is extra demand with no established cause.","plan_name":"General evening surge cover 18:15-20:00","rationale":"General SL slipped to 88% at 18:00 as volume climbed. The 16:00 cross-skill move ended at 18:00 and the current overtime ends at 18:30, so capacity is about to drop. Payments is running at 95-100% SL with spare capacity, so the plan moves 4 cross-skilled agents (within the 30% cap of about 7–8 agents) back to general until close. This is free, and payments should stay well above 70%. A small overtime offer covers the 18:45-20:00 tail. Estimated cost is about 3 accepted agents x 1.25 h x Rs 360, roughly Rs 1,440, which fits the roughly Rs 3,500 left of the Rs 15,000 budget after earlier offers. An IVR callback on general is a free safety valve for any spikes. Chat deflection and coaching cancellation are already active until 20:00.
